tldr: 美國長天期殖利率走高拖累晶片股，費城半導體指數跌逾 2%、S&P 500 小跌，輝達財報前夕為今日台股開盤蒙上保守氛圍。
國巨受惠 AI 伺服器 MLCC 需求攻上漲停、市值首破兆元；大立光林家六年來首度買回自家股票，業界研判 CPO 將有催化題材。
南韓地方法院限縮三星電子罷工範圍，原本市場期待的記憶體轉單效應恐落空，但 DRAM/NAND 報價仍居高不下。
川普證實原定 5/19 對伊朗的軍事行動應中東國家要求暫緩，地緣風險短線降溫，但油價與航運供應鏈仍需密切觀察。
經濟部預估 4 月外銷訂單將連 15 月正成長、金額達 870–890 億美元、年增近 50%，AI 帶動的外需循環尚未轉弱。

items.title_zh: 國巨躋身市值兆元俱樂部
items.title_en: Yageo crosses NT$1 trillion market cap on AI-MLCC demand
items.summary_zh: 被動元件龍頭國巨 5/18 不畏大盤重挫，逆勢攻上漲停 501 元，改寫去年「一拆四」後新天價，市值首度突破兆元、達 1.03 兆元，正式加入兆元股俱樂部。公司表示，AI 伺服器與高階手機帶動 MLCC 需求強勁，能見度延伸至 2H26，高規產品報價走穩。國巨突破象徵非半導體 AI 硬體供應鏈將出現新一輪估值重評。
items.summary_en: Passive-component leader Yageo defied a weak Taiex on May 18 and surged to its daily limit of NT$501, the highest since last year's 1-for-4 stock split, lifting market capitalisation to NT$1.03 trillion and earning a place in the trillion-NT$ club. Management attributes the upcycle to MLCC demand pulled by AI servers and high-end smartphones, with order visibility extending into 2H26 and pricing for high-spec parts firming. The breakthrough signals a broader rerating for the non-semiconductor AI hardware supply chain.

items.title_zh: 大立光林家六年來首見 增持自家股
items.title_en: Largan founding family buys own stock for first time in six years, CPO catalyst awaited
items.summary_zh: 公開資訊觀測站顯示，林耀英家族於 2020 年成立的閉鎖控股公司茂鈺增持大立光 100 張，是家族集中閉鎖股權後六年來首度公開市場買進。業界解讀為對未來 CPO（共同封裝光學）相關訂單的信心宣示，大立光正將精密光學能量切入 AI 資料中心光通訊互連市場。
items.summary_en: Disclosures show 茂鈺, the family holding vehicle set up in 2020 to consolidate ownership of optical-lens leader Largan, increased its stake by 100 lots—the family's first open-market buy since locking up holdings six years ago. Industry observers read the move as a confidence signal ahead of expected Co-Packaged Optics (CPO) related order news, where Largan is positioning its precision optics capability for AI-data-centre interconnect.

items.title_zh: 和大擬取得格斯電池經營權 沈國榮有望出任新董座
items.title_en: Hota Industrial set to take operating control of Gus Battery
items.summary_zh: 汽車齒輪大廠和大將取得電動車電池廠商格斯電池經營權，總裁沈國榮可望出任新董座。本案延續和大從內燃機齒輪跨入電動動力鏈的轉型布局，也為格斯在競爭激烈的台灣電池產業帶來資金與營運奧援。
items.summary_en: Auto-gear specialist Hota Industrial is poised to take operating control of EV battery firm Gus Battery, with chairman Shen Kuo-jung tipped to assume the chair role at the target company. The deal extends Hota's pivot from internal-combustion gears into the electrified-powertrain value chain and provides Gus with deeper capital and operating support amid Taiwan's competitive battery landscape.

items.title_zh: 三星電子罷工範圍遭法院限縮 台廠轉單效應恐落空
items.title_en: Court limits Samsung strike scope; Taiwan memory order-shift effect fades
items.summary_zh: 南韓地方法院核准三星電子限制工會罷工範圍的聲請，要求工會必須確保不至於中斷生產，否則每日重罰。裁定大幅壓縮台灣 DRAM/NAND 廠原本布局的轉單窗口，市場對「一次性轉單紅利」的期待降溫，但記憶體結構性供給偏緊的格局未變。
items.summary_en: A Korean district court approved Samsung Electronics' request to restrict the planned strike by its largest-ever union action, requiring the union to ensure production continuity or face daily penalties. The ruling materially limits the disruption window that Taiwanese DRAM/NAND suppliers had been positioning for, and tempers expectations of a one-off order-shift windfall, though structural memory tightness remains.

items.title_zh: 低軌衛星台鏈布局加速 昇達科、鐳洋、啟碁等動能可期
items.title_en: LEO satellite Taiwan chain targets NT$284.6 bn output as 60 firms join global supply
items.summary_zh: 經濟部統計，至 2025 年底已有 55 家台廠打進國際低軌衛星供應鏈，太空產業產值衝上 2,771 億元；2026 年目標再添至 60 家、產值挑戰 2,846 億元。受惠廠商涵蓋昇達科、鐳洋、啟碁等，搭配 AI 與韌性通訊需求，衛星寬頻建置週期持續加速。
items.summary_en: MOEA reports 55 Taiwan suppliers had won spots in global low-earth-orbit satellite supply chains by year-end 2025, lifting the space industry's output to NT$277.1 bn, with the 2026 target raised to 60 firms and NT$284.6 bn. Beneficiaries include 昇達科 (Universal Microwave), 鐳洋 (Rapidtek) and 啟碁 (Sercomm), as the satellite-internet build-out cycle accelerates alongside AI and resilient-comms demand.

items.title_zh: 記憶體報價走高 二手翻新機走紅 矽創、敦泰迎大單
items.title_en: DRAM price surge pushes mid/low-end phone OEMs toward refurbished sets; Sitronix, FocalTech win orders
items.summary_zh: DRAM/NAND 報價持續走高，壓縮中低階智慧手機毛利，中國與印度品牌轉而擴大翻新機（refurbished）市場，連帶帶動顯示驅動 IC 訂單。矽創、敦泰被點名為主要受惠廠，凸顯記憶體通膨正重塑手機 BOM 經濟學。
items.summary_en: Persistent DRAM/NAND price increases are squeezing margins on entry- and mid-tier smartphones, prompting Chinese and Indian OEMs to expand the refurbished-handset segment. Display-driver suppliers 矽創 (Sitronix) and 敦泰 (FocalTech) are reportedly the main winners of the resulting component orders, illustrating how memory inflation is reshaping the smartphone bill-of-materials economics.

items.title_zh: 聯發科、高通鞏固手機晶片版圖
items.title_en: MediaTek and Qualcomm tighten duopoly grip on smartphone SoC market
items.summary_zh: 最新產業數據顯示，聯發科與高通持續鞏固全球手機 SoC 市占率，二線挑戰者空間有限。兩大廠押注端側 AI 與 3nm/4nm 製程優勢，於 2H26 新機週期前對手機品牌客戶的議價能力進一步上升。
items.summary_en: Latest industry data shows MediaTek and Qualcomm continue to consolidate share in the global mobile-SoC market, leaving little room for second-tier challengers as both vendors lean into AI-on-device features and 3nm/4nm process advantages. The duopoly increases bargaining power against handset OEMs entering 2H26 product cycles.

items.title_zh: 大型 CSP 繳出亮麗成績單 老 AI 股能否搭輝達財報再衝一波
items.title_en: Strong hyperscaler capex sets up old-AI plays ahead of NVIDIA earnings
items.summary_zh: 美國主要雲端服務供應商（CSP）最新財報釋出強勁資本支出展望，對台灣 ODM、伺服器主機板與散熱「老 AI 股」帶來想像空間；市場焦點轉向即將公布的輝達財報，是否再次成為 AI 硬體循環下一波催化劑。
items.summary_en: Major US cloud service providers (CSPs) delivered upbeat capex outlooks in their latest results, with implications for Taiwan's "old-AI" ODM, server-board and thermal names. Market attention now pivots to NVIDIA's upcoming print as the next catalyst for the AI hardware cycle's next leg.

items.title_zh: 2026 台北國際電腦展 輝達新平台、機器人成焦點
items.title_en: Computex 2026 spotlight: NVIDIA's new platform and humanoid robots
items.summary_zh: 今年 Computex 主軸鎖定輝達下一代 AI 平台亮相及機器人應用，台灣 ODM/OEM 全面端出伺服器、散熱與邊緣運算解決方案，再次確立台灣在全球 AI 硬體建置中不可替代的位置。
items.summary_en: This year's Computex in Taipei centres on NVIDIA's next-generation AI platform unveil and a deep robotics line-up, with island-wide ODMs/OEMs demonstrating server, cooling and edge solutions. The show reinforces Taiwan's role as the indispensable hardware partner for the global AI build-out.

items.title_zh: CIP 傳出售彰化離岸風場 經濟部：未收申請、未見退出疑慮
items.title_en: CIP reportedly weighing sale of Changhua offshore wind farm; MOEA says no formal filing yet
items.summary_zh: 彭博引述知情人士報導，丹麥 CIP 與泰國 PTT 旗下 GPSC 正考慮出售或部分轉讓在台灣的彰芳暨西島離岸風場。經濟部表示尚未收到任何申請、亦未見退出市場跡象，但消息再度引發市場對台灣離岸風場專案財務可行性的關注。
items.summary_en: Bloomberg sources say Denmark's Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners (CIP) and Thailand's PTT-affiliated GPSC are considering exiting—either fully or partially—their Changfang & Xidao offshore wind project in Taiwan. The MOEA stressed it has received no formal application and saw no signs of a market exit, but the report adds to investor scrutiny of offshore-wind project economics in Taiwan.

items.title_zh: 遠雄港董座葉鈞耀：抓住榮景 躍居 AI 鏈隱形房東
items.title_en: Far Eastern Air Logistics chair Yeh: positioning as the AI supply chain's invisible landlord
items.summary_zh: 遠雄港董座葉鈞耀專訪指出，集團善用物流園區資產服務 AI 伺服器與高值貨運需求，定位為 AI 硬體生態的「隱形房東」，每坪租金收益顯著提升。
items.summary_en: In an interview, Far Eastern Air Logistics (遠雄港) chair Yeh Chun-yao outlines how the group leverages its logistics-park footprint to serve AI server and high-value-cargo demand, reshaping itself into a "hidden landlord" for the AI hardware ecosystem and earning higher rental yields per square metre.

items.title_zh: 天逸集團假交易真掏空案 藏鏡人溫峰泰滯留海外多年遭逮 北檢漏夜偵訊
items.title_en: Tien Yi Group "fake-trade real-embezzlement" mastermind Wen Feng-tai arrested after years overseas
items.summary_zh: 天逸集團涉嫌以「假交易、真掏空」掏空公司資金，藏鏡人溫峰泰在海外滯留多年後遭逮，北檢漏夜偵訊。本案再度引發對關係人貿易融資安排與銀行授信實質審查機制的關注。
items.summary_en: Prosecutors took into overnight questioning Wen Feng-tai, identified as the behind-the-scenes mastermind of the Tien Yi (天逸) Group case involving fake trade transactions and embezzlement of corporate funds. Wen had been in hiding overseas for years; his arrest reopens scrutiny of related-party trade financing arrangements and bank credit-due-diligence practices in trade finance.

items.title_zh: 凱基投信投資長歐陽渭棠：艦隊策略 掌握長多
items.title_en: KGI Investment CIO Ou-Yang Wei-Tang: "fleet strategy" to capture the long-term uptrend
items.summary_zh: 在經濟日報「投資大趨勢論壇」上，凱基投信投資長歐陽渭棠提出「艦隊策略」因應 AI 結構性循環：以 AI 主流大型股為旗艦，搭配供應鏈衛星部位與增益型收益基金，兼顧成長性與回檔控制，適合財管客戶長線布局。
items.summary_en: At the Economic Daily News Investment Mega-Trend Forum, KGI Investment Trust CIO Ou-Yang Wei-Tang outlined a "fleet strategy" for navigating the structural AI cycle: combining flagship AI mega-caps with satellite positions in supply-chain beneficiaries and yield-enhancing income funds to balance growth and drawdown control for wealth-management clients.

items.title_zh: 元大投信董事長劉宗聖：ETF 市場 三大機會
items.title_en: Yuanta ITC chairman Liu Tsung-Sheng: three opportunities in the ETF market
items.summary_zh: 元大投信董事長劉宗聖點出 ETF 市場三大機會：AI/科技主題 ETF、結合主動選股的高息收 ETF，以及因應利率波動的全球多元資產 ETF。隨著台灣 ETF 總規模續創新高，投信與銀行財管平台持續強化 ETF 模型組合產品線。
items.summary_en: Yuanta Investment Trust chairman Liu Tsung-Sheng identified three forward opportunities in the Taiwan ETF market: AI/technology theme ETFs, high-dividend income ETFs with active overlay, and global multi-asset ETFs that address rising rate volatility. With local ETF AUM continuing to break records, fund houses and bank wealth-management platforms are doubling down on ETF model-portfolio offerings.

items.title_zh: 行動工商憑證正式上線 首年推 18 萬家企業上鏈
items.title_en: Mobile e-business certificate goes live: tax filing, e-invoice, labour-insurance enrolment all on a smartphone
items.summary_zh: 經濟部商業發展署 5/18 宣布行動工商憑證上線，企業負責人與高階主管未來可透過手機完成報稅、開發票、勞健保加退保、合約用印等程序，無需實體 IC 卡。經濟部以首年 18 萬家企業商號為目標，加速全國約 56 萬家工商憑證用戶邁向行動化、無插卡時代。對企業稅務與行政成本影響顯著。
items.summary_en: MOEA's Department of Commerce launched the Mobile Business Certificate (行動工商憑證) on May 18, enabling company representatives and senior executives to complete tax filing, e-invoice issuance, labour/health-insurance enrolments and contract e-signing directly via mobile—without a physical IC card. The agency targets 180,000 enterprises and businesses in the first year, accelerating the cardless digital-government transition for Taiwan's ~560,000 entity-card holders.

items.title_zh: 外銷訂單估連 15 月成長 4 月接單估 870–890 億美元 年增近 50%
items.title_en: April export orders forecast at US$87–89 bn, +50% YoY for 15th straight monthly gain
items.summary_zh: 經濟部預估 4 月外銷訂單將達 870–890 億美元，年增近 50%、連 15 月正成長。AI 伺服器、先進製程 IC 與高階手機為主要拉動力，數據強化 AI 帶動外需循環的結構性穩健性，並支撐 2026 全年 GDP 預估上修。
items.summary_en: The MOEA expects Taiwan's April export orders to land at US$87–89 bn, an annual rise of nearly 50% that would mark the 15th consecutive month of growth. The pull is driven by AI servers, advanced-node ICs and high-end smartphones; the print reinforces the structural strength of the AI-led external-demand cycle and supports upward revisions to FY26 GDP forecasts.

items.title_zh: 美光、台積電大案挹注 前 4 月僑外與對外投資金額成長
items.title_en: Micron and TSMC large cases drive YTD inbound/outbound investment growth
items.summary_zh: 投審會資料顯示，美光與台積電大型投資案推升 2026 年前 4 月僑外投資與對外投資金額同步成長，反映全球半導體資本支出再配置，台灣同時扮演「先進封裝吸引外資」與「海外擴廠輸出資本」雙重角色。
items.summary_en: MOEA Investment Commission data show that mega-deals from Micron and TSMC have propelled inbound foreign investment (僑外投資) and outbound investment (對外投資) growth in the first four months of 2026. The pattern reflects the global semiconductor capex realignment, with Taiwan a key node both as inbound destination (for advanced packaging) and outbound investor (overseas fab build-outs).

items.title_zh: 中東衝突效應 瀝青、塑膠、機電設備齊揚 營造工程物價指數三年新高
items.title_en: Middle East tensions push construction price index to three-year high
items.summary_zh: 中東衝突推升瀝青、塑膠製品與機電設備價格，使台灣營造工程物價指數攀上三年新高。對基礎建設預算、營建商與公共工程承包商帶來新一波投入成本壓力，連帶影響房價可負擔性與政府資本支出規劃。
items.summary_en: Middle East conflict has lifted prices of asphalt, plastics and electromechanical equipment, sending Taiwan's Construction Engineering Price Index to a three-year high. The print signals renewed input-cost pressure for infrastructure budgets, real-estate developers and public-works contractors, with knock-on effects on housing affordability and government capex plans.

items.title_zh: 主計總處：七成勞工賺不到平均薪資
items.title_en: DGBAS: 70% of Taiwan workers earn below the average wage
items.summary_zh: 主計總處最新統計顯示，台灣約七成勞工月薪低於平均水準，凸顯 AI 帶動的總體成長與中下層家庭所得之間的落差。數據將持續影響所得分配、家庭稅負與消費韌性的政策辯論。
items.summary_en: Latest Directorate-General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics (DGBAS) data show ~70% of Taiwan's wage earners receive incomes below the published mean monthly wage, underscoring the gap between AI-driven aggregate growth and bottom-half household income. The figure feeds the ongoing policy debate on income distribution, household tax burden and consumption resilience.

items.title_zh: 賴政府 520 二周年 朝野盤點產業與能源攻防
items.title_en: Lai Ching-te marks two years in office: industry and energy policy taking stock
items.summary_zh: 5/20 賴清德總統任期過半，朝野立委同步檢視政府成績單：股市攻上 4 萬點、出口與 GDP 受惠 AI 表現亮眼，但傳產與能源轉型仍是壓力。未來兩年政策重點預計聚焦於產業升級、能源結構與稅制改革。
items.summary_en: As May 20 marks the midpoint of President Lai's term, both ruling and opposition legislators review the administration's report card: the Taiex broke 40,000, exports and GDP look strong on the AI tailwind, but traditional sectors and energy transition remain pressure points. The next two years' policy debate is expected to focus on industrial upgrading, energy mix and tax reform.

items.title_zh: 美股收盤／S&P 500 小跌 費半重挫逾 2% 殖利率飆高晶片股淪重災區
items.title_en: Wall Street close: S&P 500 slips, SOX down >2% as long-end yields surge hits chips
items.summary_zh: 美股最新交易日收低，S&P 500 微跌、費城半導體指數跌逾 2%，長天期公債殖利率彈升衝擊高估值成長與晶片股。殖利率彈升反映赤字供給與通膨黏性的疑慮，台北開盤預料消化此一風險訊號，尤以 AI 半導體權值股壓力較大，輝達財報前夕走勢更為敏感。
items.summary_en: US equities ended the latest session lower, with the S&P 500 modestly down and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index (SOX) falling more than 2% as a sharp rise in long-end Treasury yields disproportionately hit growth and chip names. The yield reset reflects concerns about deficit-driven supply and sticky inflation; Taipei's open is likely to digest this risk-off cue, especially across AI semiconductor names ahead of NVIDIA's earnings.

items.title_zh: 川普：原定 5/19 對伊朗發動攻擊 應中東國家要求暫緩
items.title_en: Trump postpones planned May 19 strike on Iran at request of Middle East partners
items.summary_zh: 川普證實原訂 5/19 對伊朗的軍事行動，應中東國家請求暫緩以保留談判空間。短線壓低油價與航運的地緣風險溢酬，但對峙結構未解，能源、國防與紅海航運相關部位仍須留意。
items.summary_en: Former-and-incoming US President Trump confirmed that a planned May 19 military action against Iran has been postponed at the request of Middle East partner countries seeking time for negotiation. The pause cools immediate geopolitical risk premia in oil and shipping markets but leaves the underlying confrontation dynamic unresolved—a relevant overhang for energy, defence and Red Sea shipping exposures.
